description: Start a running timer on a card. Idempotent: starting an already-running timer for the same person is a no-op, not an error. Optional userEmail delegates the timer to another workspace member (e.g. relaying a Slack action) — resolved against THIS workspace's membership only.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.
